host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the CalDAV/CardDAV server to.

ssl_certificate.description: Path to SSL certificate (PEM format); leave empty to use HTTP only.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key (PEM format); required if ssl_certificate is set.

server.description: Network and TLS configuration for the server.

path.description: Root directory containing per-user Git repositories.

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files during sync operations.

auto_create.description: Automatically create Git repositories for new users on first access.

git_template.description: Path to a Git template directory used when initializing new repositories (optional).

htpasswd_file.description: Path to Apache-compatible htpasswd file (required for 'basic' and 'digest' auth).

realm.description: Auth realm string used in digest authentication.

ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN to search for users (e.g., 'dc=example,dc=com').

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP filter used to locate a user by login; '%s' is substituted with username.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as for LDAP searches (empty for anonymous bind).

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind DN (required only if bind_dn is set).

file.description: Path to log file (empty means log to stderr).

web_ui_path.description: Path prefix for Calypso web UI (e.g., '/calypso'); leave blank to disable.

default_calendar.description: Default calendar name when none is specified in request.

well_known.description: Enable /.well-known/caldav and /.well-known/carddav redirection to root path.

paths.description: URL path and default resource naming.

name.description: Unique section identifier; typically same as user name.

user.description: Username (Unix user or LDAP DN) allowed access to this repository.

displayname.description: Human-readable display name (used in WebUI and CalDAV reports).

acl.description: Default access control for user: 'ro' (read-only) or 'rw' (read-write).

items.description: Repository definition; each entry creates a named section in the config.

repositories.description: List of per-user (or per-repo) configuration blocks. Each item defines access to a Git-backed calendar or addressbook.
